text:
anna_devex: Heads-up: reproducible issue with samplekit bootflow + JSON mode when fncall helper is enabled. Onboarding sample app returns an array where schema expects object.

miguel_sdk: repro steps?

essa_ci: shared a minimal repro in gist: https://gist.github.com/fake-repro (see payload + curl).

miguel_sdk: thanks, looking. saw this earlier — suspects auth/retry wrapper double-encodes when token refresh happens. Can you paste the request/response logs?

anna_devex: logs:
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <token>
body: {"mode":"json","tool_call":true,"input":"..."}
response: [ {"name":"result","value":"..."} ]
```

taylor_eng: hmmm, streaming vs non-streaming path do different coercions. If retry happens during streaming fallback we coerce into array. @miguel_sdk that's the parity bug? :thinking_face:

miguel_sdk: yep. the SDK helper's schema validator expects an object, but the parse pipeline wraps things into array in the retry codepath. Fix: normalize in helper before schema-validate. I'll make a small patch.

chun_ml: can we add unit + e2e in samplekit to catch race? Also add lint rule to flag direct array->schema coercions.

miguel_sdk: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/542 (wip). Adds normalizeResponse() and test. Needs reviewer.

anna_devex: quick workaround for onboarding: set REDWOOD_JSONMODE_STRICT=false in env to bypass strict array coercion. Documented in samplekit README.

ci-bot: deploy check started for branch pr-542 — lint OK, unit tests failing in python sdk parity tests.

miguel_sdk: fixing python parity now, likely different path name. Will ping when green.

anna_devex: thanks — this was causing 2 customers to hit onboarding friction this week. Good catch.

miguel_sdk: fixed python tests, CI green. Merging in 30.

taylor_eng: can we follow-up to add a small observability metric to catch array-when-object? put it in Redwood Optimize alerts.

chun_ml: added ticket INF-2384 for metric and alert.

anna_devex: closing loop — updated samplekit quickstart and added a note in the onboarding checklist. :party:
